errors.evidence: The description claims that the sectors are arranged in descending order of size. However, the actual order of percentages clockwise from the top is 31%, 30%, 11%, and 28%. This is not a descending order because 11% is smaller than 28%.

The description states the legend is in the top left corner. While it starts in the top left, it spans across the top towards the center of the chart. A more accurate description would be "at the top of the chart".
